description: Cryptocurrency fundamental analysis tools via MCP. Provides educational scoring and valuation data to help users conduct their own research. TVR's scoring model evaluates cryptocurrencies across 8 fundamental metrics rooted in Sound Value principles, producing TVR Scores (0-100), TVR Estimated Values, and Valuation Categories. 6 free tools and 5 premium tools are available. Coverage is expanding regularly. All outputs are model-derived assessments for informational purposes only.

findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.
